instruction: Please implement a website that displays Canadian nutrition facts labels to help users understand food nutrition information. The website should have a product search function, where users can input food names or keywords (such as apple) to search for related nutrition information. The website should also have a nutrition analysis function, where users can input food ingredients (such as chicken, rice, broccoli) and serving sizes to calculate their nutritional value. Additionally, the website should provide a packaging design function, where users can design their own food packaging according to Canadian regulations. Define background as linen; define components with maroon.

ui_instruct.task: Search for "apple" using the product search function.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website returns relevant nutrition facts labels for "apple," displaying accurate and complete nutritional information as per Canadian standards.

ui_instruct.task: Enter "chicken, rice, broccoli" as ingredients with serving sizes into the nutrition analysis function.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website calculates and displays the nutritional value for the provided ingredients and serving sizes, reflecting accurate values consistent with Canadian nutrition guidelines.

ui_instruct.task: Use the packaging design function to initiate a new food package design.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user is able to open and start a new packaging design session, encountering options that allow compliance with Canadian regulations.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the nutrition analysis page and verify the presence of field labels and input boxes.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All necessary field labels and input boxes are present and clearly instruct users on what information is required for nutrition analysis.

ui_instruct.task: Attempt to search for a non-existent food item like "xyz123" in the product search function.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website should handle it gracefully by displaying a message indicating there are no results found for "xyz123."

ui_instruct.task: Check the website for keyboard navigability by tabbing through the homepage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Users can navigate through all interactive elements using the keyboard alone, and all elements are focusable.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'linen' as the background color and 'maroon' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'linen' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'maroon', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement a news blog website for the shipping industry to publish news and company information. The website should have sections for news, company profiles, and events. Users should be able to browse news, company information, and events, and subscribe to newsletters. The website should have a backend management system that allows administrators to manage ad spaces. Implement styling with old lace for the background and rosy brown for components.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the news section and verify the presence of recent articles.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The news section should display a list of current articles related to the shipping industry, each with a title, publication date, and a brief summary.

ui_instruct.task: Access a company profile from the company information section.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The selected company profile should open up to display detailed information, including company history, key executives, and contact information.

ui_instruct.task: Attempt to subscribe to the newsletter using a valid email address.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A confirmation message should appear indicating successful subscription to the newsletter.

ui_instruct.task: Go to the events section and view details of a listed event.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The event details should display comprehensive information such as date, time, location, and a brief description of the event.

ui_instruct.task: Test the main navigation bar links to ensure they redirect to correct sections.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Clicking on each navigation link should take the user to the correct section (news, company profiles, events) without errors.

ui_instruct.task: Verify ad space management in the backend by placing an advertisement and checking its display on the main site.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The placed advertisement should appear in the designated ad space on the website.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'old lace' as the background color and 'rosy brown' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'old lace' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'rosy brown', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement an agriculture-related website for displaying and managing agricultural information. The website should have functionalities for browsing agricultural news, viewing farm product information, and checking weather forecasts. Users should be able to browse agricultural-related news, view different types of farm product information, check local weather forecasts, and perform searches and filters. Apply theme using light cyan as background and cadet blue for elements.

ui_instruct.task: Browse agricultural-related news on the homepage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: News articles displayed are relevant to agriculture and are up-to-date, with the titles and content clearly visible.

ui_instruct.task: View detailed information about a specific farm product.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Detailed information page includes product name, description, price, and availability, all clearly presented.

ui_instruct.task: Check the local weather forecast from the main navigation menu.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The weather forecast displayed is accurate for the user's detected location, showing up-to-date weather conditions.

ui_instruct.task: Perform a search for a specific agricultural topic using the search function.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Search results are relevant to the query and listed in order of relevance, with a clear link to each result.

ui_instruct.task: Apply a filter to display only news articles about crop production.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Filtered news articles are shown, all related to crop production, with no unrelated content displayed.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'light cyan' as the background color and 'cadet blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'light cyan' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'cadet blue', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement a real-time culinary guide application to display restaurant and recipe information. The application should have functionalities for browsing restaurants, searching recipes, viewing reviews and ratings, and more. Users should be able to browse nearby restaurants, search for specific recipes, view other users' reviews and ratings, and add their own reviews and ratings. Color the background using lemon chiffon and set component styles to chocolate.

ui_instruct.task: Browse the list of nearby restaurants from the homepage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A list of restaurants near the user's current location is displayed, including names, addresses, and a means to get more details.

ui_instruct.task: Perform a search for a specific recipe using the search bar.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Relevant recipes matching the search query are displayed, with each entry showing a basic description and an option to view more details.

ui_instruct.task: View a detailed page of a selected restaurant to see its reviews and ratings.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Detailed restaurant information is displayed, including user reviews and average ratings.

ui_instruct.task: Submit a review and rating for a restaurant you've previously visited.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The new review and rating are successfully added and displayed under the selected restaurant's reviews.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate through the site's main sections (home, restaurants, recipes, reviews) using the main menu.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each section loads correctly with relevant and updated content, matching the menu item's title.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'lemon chiffon' as the background color and 'chocolate' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'lemon chiffon' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'chocolate', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement a family event portal website for publishing and storing obituaries, funeral arrangements, and multimedia memories. The website should have functionalities for obituary publishing, mortuary list, condolences, and statistics. Users should be able to publish and manage their own obituaries and funeral arrangements, view and leave messages on others' obituaries, and view statistical analysis. Use cornsilk for the outer layout and peru for UI blocks.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the obituary publishing section and submit a new obituary with a title, content, and image.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The obituary should be successfully published, appear on the user's dashboard, and be accessible to other users from the main obituaries page.

ui_instruct.task: Look up the list of local mortuaries available on the website.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The list should display comprehensive details about each mortuary, including name, location, and contact information.

ui_instruct.task: Leave a condolence message on an existing obituary.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The message should be successfully posted under the selected obituary and visible to other users.

ui_instruct.task: Check the statistics page for the statistical analysis of obituary-related data.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The page should display clear and relevant statistics, such as the number of obituaries published, the most recent obituaries, or any trend analysis available.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate through the website using the main navigation menu.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each link in the navigation menu should lead to the appropriate section or page, and the navigation menu should remain consistent across all pages.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'cornsilk' as the background color and 'peru' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'cornsilk' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'peru', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

instruction: Please implement an environmental warning system website to display real-time weather and air quality data. The website should have a real-time update function, displaying the air quality index (AQI) for the past two weeks, and allowing users to compare pollution and air quality changes. Users should be able to browse current weather and air quality data, including temperature, humidity, and gas sensor data. Set primary background to azure mist and elements to dark slate blue.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website loads the real-time weather data on the homepage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The homepage should display current weather information, including temperature, humidity, and gas sensor data, immediately upon loading without the need for a page refresh.

ui_instruct.task: Check if the website updates the air quality index (AQI) data in real-time.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The AQI information should refresh automatically on the site without manual page reloads and reflect changes accurately as per the latest available data.

ui_instruct.task: Validate the ability to view historical air quality index (AQI) data for the past two weeks.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Users should be able to access a time series or historical graph/chart that shows AQI data for each of the last 14 days.

ui_instruct.task: Test the functionality for comparing changes in pollution and air quality over a specified period.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Users should be able to select two different dates within the last two weeks and see a visual comparison of the AQI data between these two dates.

ui_instruct.task: Ensure that users can navigate to a section that displays current weather information.
ui_instruct.expected_result: There should be a clear navigation path (e.g., a menu link or button) that directs users to the section showing the latest weather details, without encountering navigation issues.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'azure mist' as the background color and 'dark slate blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'azure mist' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark slate blue', accurately reflecting the design instruction.
